description: Process invocation, identity, pool telemetry, and environment knobs. Available as process:: and as /afw/_AdaptiveProcess_/current. Distinct from process environment variables (environment:: / _AdaptiveEnvironmentVariables_), request properties (request::), and server metrics (_AdaptiveServer_/current). Issue #74 identity; issue #329 telemetry and knobs.

afwVersion.description: Version string of the linked libafw at process start.
afwVersion.label: AFW Version

args.description: Command-line arguments from process start (args[0] is the program path/name as invoked). Aligns with common ECMAScript 'args' naming (issue #74). For afwfcgi this is the server binary's arguments, not HTTP parameters. Use length(process::args) for the count.
args.label: Arguments

chunkMin.description: Process default minimum posix_memalign chunk size. Heap create with chunk_min 0 uses this. Align (4k) and internal packing stay pool implementation.
chunkMin.label: Chunk Min

compileChunkMin.description: posix_memalign minimum used when creating a compile-unit heap.
compileChunkMin.label: Compile Chunk Min

cwd.description: Process current working directory snapshot at environment create. Not updated if the process later changes directory.
cwd.label: Working Directory

limitCStackHeadroomBytes.description: Tripwire: throw payload_too_large when remaining C stack is below this. 0 = unlimited.
limitCStackHeadroomBytes.label: Limit C Stack Headroom Bytes

limitEvaluationStackCount.description: Maximum Adaptive evaluation-stack frames for each xctx. The vector is allocated at this count. 0 = unlimited (lab).
limitEvaluationStackCount.label: Limit Evaluation Stack Count

limitRequestPoolBytes.description: Tripwire against request-thread ST asked-for bytes, not process poolBytesInUse. Application conf can override this and then it also applies to the CLI base thread. 0 = unlimited.
limitRequestPoolBytes.label: Limit Request Pool Bytes

memoryRegionFreeListMaxBytes.brief: Cap on thread memory_region free list
memoryRegionFreeListMaxBytes.description: Maximum bytes a thread may keep on its memory_region free list for heap-chunk reuse. 0 = posix_memalign/free on every get/free.
memoryRegionFreeListMaxBytes.label: Memory Region Free List Max Bytes

memoryRegionBytesInUse.brief: Region bytes handed out to heaps
memoryRegionBytesInUse.description: Process-wide sum of memory_region bytes currently handed out to heaps (not on a free list).
memoryRegionBytesInUse.label: Memory Region Bytes In Use

memoryRegionRegionsInUse.brief: Region count handed out to heaps
memoryRegionRegionsInUse.description: Process-wide count of memory_region allocations currently handed out to heaps.
memoryRegionRegionsInUse.label: Memory Region Regions In Use

memoryRegionFreeListBytes.brief: Bytes sitting on region free lists
memoryRegionFreeListBytes.description: Process-wide sum of bytes on thread memory_region free lists (reuse, not in a heap).
memoryRegionFreeListBytes.label: Memory Region Free List Bytes

memoryRegionFreeListCount.description: Process-wide count of memory_region allocations on thread free lists.
memoryRegionFreeListCount.label: Memory Region Free List Count

memoryRegionGetHits.brief: Region get() satisfied from a free list
memoryRegionGetHits.description: Process-wide count of memory_region get() that reused a free-list region since environment create.
memoryRegionGetHits.label: Memory Region Get Hits

memoryRegionGetMisses.description: Process-wide count of memory_region get() that called posix_memalign since environment create.
memoryRegionGetMisses.label: Memory Region Get Misses

memoryRegionFreeOverCap.brief: Region free() that called free() over cap
memoryRegionFreeOverCap.description: Process-wide count of memory_region free() that called free() because the list was at cap (including cap 0).
memoryRegionFreeOverCap.label: Memory Region Free Over Cap

memoryRegionPeakBytesInUse.brief: High-water of region bytes in use
memoryRegionPeakBytesInUse.description: High-water of memoryRegionBytesInUse since environment create.
memoryRegionPeakBytesInUse.label: Memory Region Peak Bytes In Use

memoryRegionPeakFreeListBytes.description: High-water of memoryRegionFreeListBytes since environment create.
memoryRegionPeakFreeListBytes.label: Memory Region Peak Free List Bytes

peakPoolBytesInUse.description: High-water of poolBytesInUse since environment create. Asked-for malloc/calloc (prefixes and rounding included), not process RSS.
peakPoolBytesInUse.label: Peak Pool Bytes In Use

peakPoolChunkBytes.description: High-water of poolChunkBytes since environment create. Store still mapped, not asked-for.
peakPoolChunkBytes.label: Peak Pool Chunk Bytes

pid.description: Operating system process id (or equivalent) at environment create.
pid.label: Pid

poolBytesInUse.description: Outstanding malloc/calloc AFW has not given back (prefixes and rounding included). Not process RSS; see process::rss, process_rss(), and poolChunkBytes.
poolBytesInUse.label: Pool Bytes In Use

poolChunkBytes.description: Sum of heap posix_memalign chunks still held. Store mapped, not asked-for.
poolChunkBytes.label: Pool Chunk Bytes

programName.description: Base name of args[0] (last path segment), also available as env program_name (e.g. afw, afwfcgi).
programName.label: Program Name

rss.description: Live resident set size in bytes. afw_os_get_rss() and process_rss() are kilobytes; this property multiplies by 1024. 0 if unavailable. Not poolBytesInUse.
rss.label: RSS

startTime.description: Local dateTime when the Adaptive environment was created for this process.
startTime.label: Start Time

xctxChunkMin.description: Process default posix_memalign minimum for each xctx/thread heap. Every thread starts from this.
xctxChunkMin.label: Xctx Chunk Min
